title: How Sink Drainage Works: Understanding Traps and Vents
description: Every functional sink drainage system relies on a careful balance of gravity, liquid seals, and atmospheric pressure. The P-trap beneath the sink serves a vital safety function by holding a small amount of water to block sewer gases from entering the living space. Downstream from the trap, the drain connects to a vent stack that introduces air into the piping network. This venting prevents negative pressure from siphoning the water seal out of the trap during heavy discharges. Grasping this mechanism is essential for maintaining smooth, odor-free wastewater flow in any residential building.
